dashboard_insights.name: Deliberate API requests by operation and result

measurement_notes: Request counts cover reviewed UI mutations, not polling or all backend requests.
Run metrics require a new-session active observation before a terminal outcome; no historical backfill.
Waiting is not a terminal outcome. Missing timestamps omit duration, never zero.
At most 512 runs per observer session; excess admission is dropped to preserve bounded deduplication.
Integrated run observer must receive shared telemetry leadership; separate origins/devices can still count the same daemon run. These are observed session totals, not unique daemon runs.
No traffic does not establish zero failures or healthy operation.
No cost, token, provider-call or infrastructure metrics are inferred from these observations.
